### Needed Grace
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-oct-15-2008-11582941.html
Passage: Job 15
Points:
- Eliphaz’s stinging accusation shows the harsh tone of people who completely lack grace.
- Graceless people kick those who are down, complicate confusing situations, and write off the hurting.
- Job sat grieving the sudden, traumatic loss of his adult children while enduring graceless criticism from a friend.
- Job's experience highlights the vital lesson that demonstrating grace is always appropriate and needed.
- You rarely know what personal grief someone is fighting, making encouraging words indispensable.

### Devotional: Job 15
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/genesis-49-luke-2-job-15-1-corinthians-3/
Passage: Job 15
Points:
- Eliphaz opens the second round of speeches on the attack, accusing Job of undermining reverence for God.
- Instead of addressing Job's arguments, Eliphaz falls back on the consensus and authority of the aged.
- He treats Job's longing to vindicate himself as an arrogant attempt to put God on trial.
- Eliphaz argues that God's holiness means sinful humanity inevitably suffers judgment and divine retribution.
- He insists any apparent delay in punishment is temporary, wrongly deducing that Job's catastrophe proves hidden wickedness.
